# 需求文档模板

## 文档元数据

```yaml
document:
  name: "requirements.md"
  version: "v1.0"
  status: "draft"  # draft | in_review | approved | deprecated | blocked
  created_at: "YYYY-MM-DD"
  updated_at: "YYYY-MM-DD"
  owner: "Architect"
  scenario: "new-project"  # new-project | legacy-maintenance | bug-fix

dependencies: []
blocking:
  - "architecture.md"

reviewers: []
```
